terms.ilaud: Pinned owner digital persona consumed by Carina and Keprix at the same version.
terms.consent_purpose: Versioned allow/deny purpose attached to an asset (ingest, generate, publish, and related).
terms.distribution: Separate approval, schedule, publish and private-reply actions; never implied by generation.
terms.shadow_mode: Same redacted input sent to Carina and Keprix for comparison; shadow output never publishes.
terms.wave_0: Architecture and pack work that must not change the live Carina/Aiva path.
terms.wave_1: Keprix draft memory only; Carina remains live inbound and OAuth authority.
terms.kill_switch: Operator control that blocks queued publish and media jobs immediately.
terms.outbox: Transactional publish ledger keyed by idempotency so retries cannot double-post.
